How to Play
🎯 Goal
Delve floor by floor, grab ever-better loot, and survive as deep as you can. Death sends you back to Town, lighter — but your hero lives on.
🕹️ Moving & fighting
MoveJoystick (drag anywhere), arrows / WASD, or click the map — hold to keep going, diagonals included.
SprintHold Shift, or push the stick to its edge.
DashSpace. Sprint & Dash burn stamina, which refills as you ease off.
AttackAutomatic on any foe in reach.
SkillsSkill bar or number keys (cost MP).
UseE / tap — grab loot, talk to NPCs.
Mind your footing — ice slips, mud slows, arrow traps & fire vents can be dodged. Foes roam and give chase when you're close.
💎 Loot rarity
Colour is rarity: grey → white → green → blue → purple → orange → red (Mythic). Tap loot in your bag to equip, sell, or scrap it.
Teal marks a set piece — its own top-rarity class, as rare as red. Wear 2 or 4 matching pieces for escalating bonuses; completing a set unlocks a unique power and a golden aura. Hover a "… set" tag to see them.
✨ Skills & potions
Skills cost MP and each has its own cooldown in seconds; their buttons glow gold when ready. Health & mana potions share a brief cooldown and pulse when ready to drink.
🔥 Hazards
Lava and spikes hurt more the deeper you go — step around them (you're never forced through one).
🔒 Stairs & Town
Clear every foe to unseal the glowing down-stairs (the up-stairs just backtrack). In Town, visit the Merchant, Craftsman, Healer, Mystic, Ramen House and more, then take the Dungeon Gate back down.
📜 History
♻️ Auto-Loot
When loot drops, instantly Scrap it into crafting materials or Sell it for gold by rarity, so your bag doesn't fill with junk. Default is Keep (off). Locked gear is never touched, and you can still Sell or Scrap by hand from the LOOT bag at any time.

💾 Save Slots
Keep as many heroes as you like. Load a slot to play it, or start a new adventure in a fresh slot — your current game is saved automatically.
↻ Reset Current Run?
This starts over in your current save slot (Slot 1) and permanently deletes the hero saved there. This can't be undone.
Want to keep this hero and start a second one? Use Save Slots and pick a fresh slot instead — nothing gets wiped.
☁️ Cloud Save
Optional. Sign in to link your save slots to your account so you can carry your heroes across devices. Your progress still saves on this device either way.
